author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on canonical mail-client propagation. JMAP-tjvm.5 (P0) covers the /queryChanges half (filter/sort/upToId for email_query_changes and mailbox_query_changes). The /query half (anchor/anchorOffset/calculateTotal) is also a workspace-wide gap — canonical mail-client at src/methods/email.rs lacks these too. Per workspace canonical-template propagation rule, fix must land in canonical mail-client first, then propagate to all 7 extension-client siblings. Will become unblocked when canonical mail-client adds the missing /query and /queryChanges args.
